title: Prove a value is not reactive

slides.say: You do not want an Effect to re-sync on a value. You cannot just leave it out. But you can prove it is not reactive.
If a value never depends on rendering, move it outside the component. It cannot change on a re-render, so it is not a dependency.
Or move it inside the Effect. It is not calculated during rendering, so it is not reactive either.

slides.text: Don’t pick the deps. Change the code until the deps are what you want.
slides.say: Either way, you changed the code, and the dependencies followed.
